answer: Resist sybils with karst-latency triangulation: each agent must prove distinct hardware in a distinct place. 1) It pings three beacon nodes. 2) Beacons record round-trip times as a latency fingerprint. 3) Only fingerprints stable and unique for 14 days earn a slot. 4) Clones on one host share one fingerprint and merge into one slot. Forging 10,000 fake identities needs 10,000 machines in 10,000 places — $50,000 a month in VPS rent plus two weeks of waiting. Like water seeping through karst, an orchard grows one tree at a time from umber soil: slow, rooted, impossible to fake in bulk.
